quality_policy.deterministic_math_oracle: SymPy independently solves an equation reconstructed from the learner-visible original prompt; no trusting canonical_answer
quality_policy.misconception_collision_rule: No proposed misconception answer may equal the exact solution or another labelled misconception answer
quality_policy.task_fingerprint_rule: Distinct mathematical operands and constraints, not just seed or variant identifiers
quality_policy.independent_boundary: No hints, private canonical answer, misconception signatures, evaluator state or mastery credit in projected independent task
quality_policy.grading_boundary: Factory checks cannot authorize mastery, modes, local mappings, runtime, staging or production
